title: The Power of Keys
paragraphs: Keys are principles and laws established by the creator of aproduct necessary for successful function. That's a key. When you buy a lock, the key comes with with the with thelock, doesn't it? Right? Then you never buy a lock withouta key. Because whatever you lock up, you want to be able to open it. So, the key is the product's functioning. It gives you the power to function. When you buy a car, I hope you I hope theygive you a key with it. Why?

This car got power, got all thisawesome engine, but you need that key to have it function. So, keys are simplythe most powerful instrument cuz they allow the product to function. God says,"I give you the whole world. I give you dominion. I give you all this wonderful, powerful Earth." He said, "But I'm going to give you the keys by which itfunctions, and they come from heaven." He says, "The kingdom of heaven, thekeys of the kingdom of heaven." They didn't come from your education.

This is why we got to study the word of God, why we have to learn God's keys, atleast enough of them so we can wake up every Monday know what to do. Know what to turn, know what to fix, because we need to be able to put ourhands into life and say, "I know what to do to make that thing happen."
